name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit_summary: Free soil testing every 2 years with a report on nutrient status and fertilizer/dosage recommendations — increasingly required before applying for other input-based subsidies
required_documents: 7/12 utara (land record) or proof of land under cultivation
notes: VERIFY against your own soil_health_card.txt — as of recent updates this card is being made mandatory as a prerequisite for fertilizer and seed subsidies in some states, confirm current requirement status.
